description: Details of one element by ref or CSS selector, without a snapshot: tag, role/name, all attributes (href, src, value, aria-*, data-*…), text, visibility, enabled/checked state and its viewport box (for click_at / drag). Cheap way to read a link's URL or an input's value.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12".

name: element_info
